HOW IT WORKS

ScalaOS

ScalaOS designs superior proteins with greater speed and accuracy, resulting in shorter time to market and higher success rates.

​

Our software platform fuses atomistic calculations, evolutionary data, and AI modeling to generate high-performance proteins in a single design round. We introduce dozens of beneficial mutations at once, significantly improving protein stability and activity while avoiding repeated iterations.

​

Whether you're designing an enzyme, an antibody, or any other protein, ScalaOS delivers faster, more reliable results.

​

Inherent instability of glucocerebrosidase (GCase), limiting therapeutic efficacy for neuronal Gaucher disease.

  • Single design round

WHAT WE DO

About Scala

At Scala Biodesign, we develop computational protein design technologies to optimize enzymes, antibodies, therapeutic proteins, and antigens across diverse industries.

 

Our proven in silico platforms integrate structure-based and sequence-based calculations, delivering faster, more reliable solutions to complex protein engineering challenges, all in a single design round.

 

Whether you're developing novel biocatalysts for green chemistry, designing complex antigens, or optimizing biologics and vaccines, ScalaOS, our cloud-based platform, empowers you to accelerate R&D while reducing time and costs.

Contact us

Founding Team

Our founding team has over a decade of experience developing cutting-edge protein design methods. 

We established Scala to elevate protein design to the scale and reliability that are needed by the biotechnology and biopharmaceutical industries.
